title: 2501 E County Highway 30A | Royal Destinations
meta_description: New Construction-2nd Tier-Private Pool-Amazing Gulf Views-Semi-Private Beach!
description_expanded: Description: 2501 E County Highway 30A by Royal Destinations Location: Old Seagrove Beach Bordering Seaside Address: 2501 E County Highway 30A, Santa Rosa Beach, FL 32459 Details: This stately newly constructed home offers everything the most discerning traveler would expect coming to 30A. This home offers rare semi-private beach use shared with two other homes directly across the street! From the private en suite accommodations to the beautiful courtyard with private pool, this home is a work of art. Located directly across from the Gulf and the stunning white sand beaches, bordering the quaint and famous village of Seaside, the location cannot be beat. Home Highlights: - Semi-Private Beach Use Accessible Directly Across from Home (Beach Use Shared with Two Other Homes) - All En Suite - Amazing Gulf Views - Beach Towels Provided During Stay - Elevator - Fronting 30A and Bordering the Village of Seaside - New Construction - Professional Décor - Outdoor Shower - Media/Game Room - Private Pool with Fountains - Outdoor Lanai * Pool Heat is available for an additional $330 (pre-tax). * The pool heater does require 24 hours to reach the optimal temperature of 83-85 degrees. * Please contact Reservations to add this feature prior to your stay. Home Configuration + Sleeping Arrangements: Sleeps: 22 7 Bedrooms / 7 Full Baths / 3 Half Baths / 1 Beach Shower First Floor: - Bedroom 1: King Suite with Private Bath (Vessel Tub, Separate Shower), Smart TV - Bedroom 2: King Suite with Private Bath (Shower), Smart TV - Media Room, Sleeper Sofa, Media Room Bath, Laundry, Elevator to all Floors - Additional Full Bath and Additional Half Bath - Pool Courtyard, Private Pool, Half Bath, Outdoor Living, Beach Shower Second Floor: - Bedroom 3: King Suite with Private Bath, Smart TV - Bedroom 4: Two Full Beds with Private Bath, Smart TV - Open Concept Great Room Including Living, Kitchen, Dining, Covered Porch with Seating, Half Bath, Laundry Third Floor: - Bedroom 5: King Suite with Private Bath (Shower), Private Living Room, TV, Terrace with Seating, Stunning Gulf Views - Bedroom 6: Bunk Room - Two Sets of Twin Beds (Shared Full Bath) - Bedroom 7: Bunk Room - Two Sets of Twin Bunk Beds (Shared Full Bath) - Game/Media Room, Half Bath Amenities Include: - 8 Adult Bikes - 2 Beach Service Sets (Seasonal: March - October) Please Note: Beach access locations and beach vending companies are subject to change, per local county ordinances. For the most up-to-date information, please contact our office prior to your arrival. Lined with artsy villages, coastal lakes, upscale boutiques, eclectic beach bars, and world-class restaurants, Florida's Scenic Highway 30A has something for everyone. This unique destination has 25,000 acres of protected habitats. Among many things, this area is known for its family-friendly environment and is home to the world's most beautiful white sand beaches. The Timpoochee Trail bike path connects all the villages of 30A. Be sure to take your bike out and explore! The villages of 30A include Dune Allen Beach, Blue Mountain Beach, Grayton Beach, WaterColor, Seaside, Seagrove Beach, WaterSound, Alys Beach, Seacrest Beach, Rosemary Beach, and Inlet Beach.
